entities.name: Karol Rómmel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karol Rómmel was a Polish and Russian military officer, sportsman and horse rider. He competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics, the 1924 Summer Olympics, and in the 1928 Summer Olympics. As a military officer he served with distinction in World War I and the Polish-Bolshevist War.
